reading: The short-necked oil beetle has been rediscovered in Pembrokeshire after an apparent absence of 60 years from Wales.
Recent surveys had prompted fears of local extinction, meaning that the beetle might no longer exist in Wales.
Across the UK, the species went unreported for almost 60 years after 1948, as habitat loss brought it to the brink of extinction.
Last year's survey at Castlemartin recorded only dead adults, prompting concern about the species' persistence at the site.
After three years of searching, experts discovered larvae, or immature beetles, in a small area of the site, suggesting that they had located part of a larger batch of young beetles.
According to Natural Resources Wales, the number and distribution of the larvae corroborated this interpretation.
Anne Hobbs, from the Bumblebee Conservation Trust, welcomed indications that the species was reproducing in Wales again.
The beetle relies on solitary bees for its life cycle and requires both thick vegetation for cover and abundant flowers.
Natural Resources Wales said these exacting habitat requirements leave only a few suitable sites in the UK.
The species is classified as nationally rare in Great Britain and is listed as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.
The beetles are typically encountered between March and June in coastal grassland rich in flowers and in sand dunes, with activity greatest on warm, sunny days.
Rediscoveries elsewhere in the UK included Devon in 2006 and the Isle of Coll in Scotland in 2009.
Castlemartin Range remains the species' only known Welsh location and is subject to sustained monitoring by conservationists.
The work forms part of Wales's flagship species recovery programme, which also seeks to conserve other species sharing similar habitats.
Hobbs stressed that effective conservation must accommodate the needs of several species.

vocabulary.definition: A period when something seems to be missing, although its actual absence has not been established.
The disappearance of a species from a particular area, even though it may continue to exist elsewhere.
A situation in which a species is close to disappearing completely.
The continued existence of a species in a location despite conditions that threaten it.
Provided additional support for an interpretation, making it more credible without necessarily proving it.
Demanding precise conditions that can be difficult to satisfy.
Assigned a conservation category indicating a significant risk of extinction.
Repeated observation maintained over time to track a situation or detect changes.
Used to identify a particularly prominent programme that represents an organisation's wider work or priorities.
Take different needs into account and make provision for them.

entries.ja: 実際にいなくなったことは確認されていないものの、いなくなったように見える期間。
entries.ko: 실제로 사라졌는지는 확인되지 않았지만, 사라진 것처럼 보이는 기간.
entries.zh-Hans: 某事物似乎不在了，但尚未证实它确实不在的一段时期。
entries.es: Periodo en el que algo parece estar ausente, aunque no se ha confirmado que realmente lo esté.
entries.pt-BR: Período em que algo parece estar ausente, embora sua ausência real não tenha sido confirmada.
entries.fr: Période pendant laquelle quelque chose semble être absent, sans que son absence réelle ait été établie.
entries.de: Ein Zeitraum, in dem etwas verschwunden zu sein scheint, obwohl sein tatsächliches Fehlen nicht nachgewiesen ist.

entries.ja: ある種が特定の地域から姿を消すこと。他の場所では生存し続けている場合もある。
entries.ko: 다른 곳에서는 계속 생존할 수도 있지만, 특정 지역에서는 한 종이 사라지는 현상.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个物种从某一特定地区消失，但它可能仍在其他地方生存。
entries.es: Desaparición de una especie de una zona determinada, aunque pueda seguir existiendo en otros lugares.
entries.pt-BR: Desaparecimento de uma espécie de uma determinada área, embora ela possa continuar existindo em outros lugares.
entries.fr: Disparition d’une espèce dans une zone donnée, même si elle peut continuer à exister ailleurs.
entries.de: Das Verschwinden einer Art aus einem bestimmten Gebiet, auch wenn sie anderswo weiterhin existieren kann.

entries.ja: ある種が完全に姿を消す寸前にある状況。
entries.ko: 한 종이 완전히 사라지기 직전에 놓인 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个物种接近完全消失的处境。
entries.es: Situación en la que una especie está cerca de desaparecer por completo.
entries.pt-BR: Situação em que uma espécie está perto de desaparecer completamente.
entries.fr: Situation dans laquelle une espèce est sur le point de disparaître complètement.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der eine Art kurz davorsteht, vollständig zu verschwinden.

entries.ja: 生存を脅かす状況にもかかわらず、ある種がその場所に存在し続けること。
entries.ko: 생존을 위협하는 조건에도 불구하고 한 종이 특정 장소에서 계속 존재하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个物种尽管面临威胁其生存的条件，仍在某个地点持续存在。
entries.es: Existencia continuada de una especie en un lugar a pesar de las condiciones que la amenazan.
entries.pt-BR: Continuidade da existência de uma espécie em um local, apesar de condições que a ameaçam.
entries.fr: Maintien d’une espèce dans un lieu malgré des conditions qui menacent son existence.
entries.de: Das Fortbestehen einer Art an einem Ort trotz Bedingungen, die sie bedrohen.

entries.ja: ある解釈を必ずしも証明したわけではないが、それをさらに裏付け、信頼性を高めた。
entries.ko: 어떤 해석을 반드시 입증한 것은 아니지만, 추가로 뒷받침하여 그 신빙성을 높였다.
entries.zh-Hans: 为某种解释提供了进一步支持，使其更可信，但不一定证明了它。
entries.es: Aportó apoyo adicional a una interpretación, haciéndola más creíble sin necesariamente demostrarla.
entries.pt-BR: Deu apoio adicional a uma interpretação, tornando-a mais convincente sem necessariamente comprová-la.
entries.fr: A apporté un appui supplémentaire à une interprétation, la rendant plus crédible sans nécessairement la prouver.
entries.de: Lieferte zusätzliche Anhaltspunkte für eine Deutung und machte sie dadurch glaubwürdiger, ohne sie unbedingt zu beweisen.

entries.ja: 満たすことが難しい場合もある、厳密な条件を要求する。
entries.ko: 충족하기 어려울 수 있는 세밀하고 정확한 조건을 요구하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 要求满足可能难以达到的精确条件。
entries.es: Que exige condiciones precisas que pueden ser difíciles de cumplir.
entries.pt-BR: Que exige condições precisas que podem ser difíceis de atender.
entries.fr: Qui exige des conditions précises pouvant être difficiles à satisfaire.
entries.de: Stellt genaue Anforderungen, die schwer zu erfüllen sein können.

entries.ja: 絶滅の危険がかなり高いことを示す保全上の区分に指定されている。
entries.ko: 상당한 멸종 위험이 있음을 나타내는 보전 등급으로 지정된.
entries.zh-Hans: 被划入表明存在较大灭绝风险的保护等级。
entries.es: Clasificado en una categoría de conservación que indica un riesgo considerable de extinción.
entries.pt-BR: Classificado em uma categoria de conservação que indica um risco significativo de extinção.
entries.fr: Classé dans une catégorie de conservation indiquant un risque important d’extinction.
entries.de: In eine Naturschutzkategorie eingestuft, die ein erhebliches Risiko des Aussterbens anzeigt.

entries.ja: 状況の推移を把握したり変化を見つけたりするために、一定の期間にわたって繰り返し観察すること。
entries.ko: 상황의 추이를 살피거나 변화를 감지하기 위해 시간을 두고 지속적으로 반복하는 관찰.
entries.zh-Hans: 为跟踪情况或发现变化而在一段时间内持续开展的反复观察。
entries.es: Observación repetida que se mantiene a lo largo del tiempo para seguir una situación o detectar cambios.
entries.pt-BR: Observação repetida e mantida ao longo do tempo para acompanhar uma situação ou detectar mudanças.
entries.fr: Observation répétée et maintenue dans le temps pour suivre une situation ou détecter des changements.
entries.de: Wiederholte Beobachtung, die über einen Zeitraum hinweg aufrechterhalten wird, um eine Situation zu verfolgen oder Veränderungen festzustellen.

entries.ja: 組織の幅広い活動や優先事項を代表する、特に目立つ事業であることを示すために使われる表現。
entries.ko: 조직의 전반적인 활동이나 우선 과제를 대표하는, 특히 두드러진 사업임을 나타낼 때 쓰는 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 用于表明某个计划格外突出，能够代表一个组织更广泛的工作或优先事项。
entries.es: Se usa para señalar un programa especialmente destacado que representa la labor más amplia o las prioridades de una organización.
entries.pt-BR: Usado para identificar um programa de especial destaque que representa o trabalho mais amplo ou as prioridades de uma organização.
entries.fr: S’emploie pour désigner un programme particulièrement en vue qui représente les activités plus larges ou les priorités d’une organisation.
entries.de: Wird verwendet, um ein besonders herausragendes Programm zu kennzeichnen, das die umfassendere Arbeit oder die Prioritäten einer Organisation repräsentiert.

entries.ja: さまざまなニーズを考慮し、それらに対応するための手立てを整える。
entries.ko: 서로 다른 필요를 고려하고 이에 대응할 방안을 마련하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 考虑不同的需求，并为满足这些需求作出安排。
entries.es: Tener en cuenta distintas necesidades y tomar medidas para atenderlas.
entries.pt-BR: Levar em conta diferentes necessidades e tomar providências para atendê-las.
entries.fr: Tenir compte de différents besoins et prévoir les moyens d’y répondre.
entries.de: Unterschiedliche Bedürfnisse berücksichtigen und Vorkehrungen treffen, um ihnen gerecht zu werden.
